items.question: What command is used to create a new Git repository?
items.explanation: git init initializes a new Git repository in the current directory.

items.question: Which command stages all changes for commit?
items.explanation: git add . stages all changes in the current directory and subdirectories.

items.question: How do you create and switch to a new branch in one command?
items.explanation: git checkout -b creates a new branch and switches to it. Modern alternative: git switch -c
